  • 深入解析主角摩根·余身處虛假現實、被困於三年記憶輪迴中的驚悚科幻反轉。
  • 詳細介紹「風暴異種」的擬態機制與「格魯砲」、「神經調整儀」等獨特黑科技設定。

摘要

評分爭議與虛假日常

作者首先提及了 2017 年發售的科幻驚悚遊戲《獵魂》（Prey），該作曾因存檔問題遭受評分爭議，但其懸疑氛圍與遊玩深度實屬頂尖。故事主角摩根·余（Morgan Yu）於 2032 年 3 月 15 日從轉星公司（TranStar）的宿舍醒來，在兄長亞歷克斯（Alex Yu）指示下搭乘直升機前往測試場。摩根經歷了包含移動箱子、躲藏以及一連串荒謬「電車難題」的奇異測試後，實驗室突然陷入混亂，摩根在衝擊波中昏迷，醒來時卻發現時間又重置回同一天清晨。

驚人真相與風暴異種的威脅

在神祕聯絡人的警示下，摩根用扳手砸破陽台玻璃，赫然揭發眼前的晴朗市景全是由螢幕投射的虛假幻象。真實年份早已是 2035 年，直升機飛行與電梯全是在同個樓層運作的模擬裝置。基地內已被能隨意擬態成茶杯、椅子等日常物品的外星生物「風暴異種」（Typhon）徹底侵佔。作者提到，摩根在此尋獲了能將生物定型並鋪設新路線的格魯砲（GLOO Cannon），以及可在短時間內大幅改造神經系統、賦予使用者頂尖技能的神經調整儀（Neuromod）。

塔洛斯一號的秘密與自毀抉擇

摩根隨後驚覺自己根本不在地球，而是身處名為「塔洛斯一號」（Talos I）的深空太空站。摩根曾作為研究主管親自進行人體實驗，但每次拔除神經調整儀都會導致記憶重置；亞歷克斯為了防止研究成果被毀，蓄意將他囚禁在同一天的記憶循環中長達三年。藉由自己過去預先留下的勤工機器人「一月」（January）引導，摩根決定找尋鑰匙藍圖以啟動太空站自毀程序，並配戴能掃描吸收異種能力的心靈掃描儀（Psychoscope），在自身逐漸異化的風險下展開絕地反擊。

Truly a professional rating agency; that explanation is just as professional. So today, let's take a look at what this masterpiece, with its ever-changing ratings, is actually about. The protagonist. Upon arriving at the center, we are greeted by a science robot. You can ask it about the company's operations and testing procedures, though if you talk too much... My brother Alex has been waiting for quite a while. He says these tests are a bit unconventional, but the Yu family has always liked breaking rules, which. is how they built such a huge business. I quickly understood why he said that, as the tests are really strange. The first task is moving a box; the second is to find a place to hide. There’s only one chair in the whole room, so where else could I hide besides behind it? The third test is to run to the other side and press the blue button—even simpler than the last one. But today, my brother Yu didn't call. The computer was full of emails from someone named " Hospital," telling Morgan to run because. it's dangerous here. As soon as he went out, he saw an alien die. Morgan grabbed a wrench dropped nearby, finally having a weapon for self-defense. This "Hospital" guy sent another voice message saying the dorm isn't safe and to leave immediately. I know that, brother, but the problem is , where's the elevator? The hallway that used to lead to the elevator has now turned into a wall. After looking around, it seems there's no other way but to use the wrench to smash the glass on the balcony. This. A shocking secret was revealed: everything he saw when he woke up every day was fake. The sunny city view was actually projected onto a screen. Behind the screen is a control room. In the middle is a computer, and things like brother Yu's calls, the sound of a helicopter landing, and even the sound of birds flying past the window were all simulated. There's a note on the desk saying February 22nd, 2035, but Morgan's memory stopped at March 15th, 2032. What on. earth is going on here? Running to the back of the room, he immediately saw the black creature that attacked the scientist. Think I'll let you go? A few steps further, he saw an even more astonishing scene. The helicopter ride to my test was actually something like a scene in a toy room that keeps changing. The footage of flying over the city was just a film; the small simulator never actually left the room. Next door is the TranStar laboratory. Even taking the elevator to the roof every day was a lie ; everything was operating on the same floor. Now, there are no living people.

here, only pervasive black monsters. They are Typhon mimics, and because they can imitate nearby objects, they are also called mimics. However, the mimicked objects often suddenly move uncontrollably. If you stare at things in the room that feel wrong, you can eventually spot the telltale signs. I soon found a new weapon, the GLOO Cannon . This is a high-tech weapon developed by TranStar; we used to call it the glue gun. This thing doesn't hurt enemies, but the ejected glue can render creatures immobile, turning them into sitting ducks. When you can't find a path later on, you can even use the glue. gun to create a new route where there wasn't one, allowing you to reach new locations. With this gun, the fun of the game has certainly increased. I soon found another piece of TranStar's black tech: the Neuromod. I had already seen this thing in various documents, and Yu said— The Neuromod is true top-tier black tech . It can alter the user's nervous system , allowing them to quickly master various technologies, engineering, and hacking skills. The more you use it, the. more skills you learn. As the description puts it, it’s a magical device that can turn you into Einstein in just 10 minutes. Yu sent a message at this time, asking Morgan to come to his office. There is a very important video that Morgan needs to see for himself. Arriving at the atrium, I discovered that where I am now isn't Earth at all, but a space station called Talos I. This was originally a space station built by the US and the Soviets. After an accident led to its closure, TranStar bought it in 2025, turning it into their vital deep-space research. base. Morgan seems to have lost a large chunk of his memory. He doesn't understand what’s going on or why he’s in outer space, so he has no choice but to go to that room he has no memory of. Morgan's. An image appears ahead; it’s a recording he made himself. It turns out that besides making skill-enhancing Neuromods, TranStar was also researching ones with Typhon abilities. The Neuromod , with Morgan as the researcher. The leader of the research team has been experimenting on himself. Currently, there is one side effect: the moment the. Neuromod is removed, memories are reset as well. They originally had ways to counter this memory loss, but Alex intentionally kept Morgan trapped in March 15, 2032, for nearly three years. The real date, as seen on the monitor earlier, is already 2035. Before he could reveal more inside information, Alex cut the connection. He claimed there was a reason for all this and said he would explain everything personally when the time was right. Morgan, of course, wouldn't just wait around; he began looking for a way to recover his memories. Besides the Phantoms you see, there are also humanoids in the base.

They were originally human but were transformed into this state after being attacked by the Typhon. We were also attacked by robots along the way. It seems the Typhon can even control robots —they are truly too powerful. We also managed to get a small pistol. Now, at least, we have both melee and ranged weapons. To connect to the server, you need to go to the workstation, and to enter the workstation, you need the keycard belonging to Dr. Calvino. The doctor had already died in space. After some effort, we entered space to retrieve the keycard, finally reconnecting the server and seeing the rest of the footage. This space station , named Talos I, has been completely. overrun. Morgan hopes he can destroy the space station entirely; otherwise, the consequences of letting the Typhon reach Earth would be unimaginable. But his brother, Alex, doesn't want the research results destroyed, which is why he created this illusion to keep Morgan trapped in the same day. However, Morgan also left a backup plan: this operator machine named January. With January's help, the current Morgan finally knows his true intentions and roughly what happened on the space station. To completely destroy the station, two keys are required. Morgan and Alex each originally had one, but Morgan's key was. destroyed by Alex. He needs to go to the Deep Storage to find the blueprint and craft a new one. So, the objective now is clear: replicate his own key, find a way to get Alex's key, and the mission will be accomplished. On the way, we found something new: the Psychoscope. This is another major invention from TranStar, besides the Neuromod; it can scan Typhon to understand their abilities and convert them into powers that you can use yourself. But this thing has a downside: using it too much makes you look more and more like a Typhon, causing the base's automated turrets to mistake the protagonist for a. Typhon and open fire immediately. So, learning it carries risks—use it with caution. Here, we encountered even more powerful Phantoms, capable of weaving golden psi-threads. We also learned that the TranStar Corporation shipped a group of death-row volunteers from Earth to study the various abilities of the Typhons as test subjects. The events now unfolding on Talos I are, unsurprisingly , the result of a failed experiment. It’s not some natural disaster at all— it's entirely a man-made catastrophe. After finally reaching the Deep Storage , we found the door locked tight. It’s voice-encrypted, requiring the voice of the department head, Daniel Sho, to. unlock. The catch is that in the current situation, Director Sho is most likely dead. With no other choice, we have to track down samples of his voice and find a way to synthesize it. We arrived at the crew quarters and found quite a few employees. The good news: we finally saw living people. The bad news: they’ve all been mind-controlled by the Telepaths and are completely incoherent. We found Sho's voice files on a computer and successfully entered the storage area to replicate our own keycard. But my brother, Alex, is acting up again and has locked us inside. Fortunately, Morgan is quick-witted and managed to use the cargo lift to escape into space . At this point, we received a distress.

signal from someone named January, who was attacked by Typhons and trapped in a cargo bay, waiting to die. There’s no other way; we can't just leave them to die. Even though he’s barely hanging on himself, the protagonist finds a way to save January and bring him back to the station. We’ve found living people here again. Sarah, the head of security, says the path to the Talos I reactor core is blocked by Typhons. To get through, we have to help them clear the area of Typhon activity first. That’s easy enough—we’ll set up some turrets, open the door, and take them on. We’ll clear out as many as they throw at us. On the way to the core, we pass through the reactor control room, where we run into. Mikhaila. The protagonist realizes, "Oh , so you're my ex-girlfriend." Morgan is suffering from amnesia and can't remember anything, including the fact that Mikhaila is his ex-girlfriend; he only learns of it through their conversation. Mikhaila is in terrible shape, and we must get to her office to retrieve a stimulant to save her life. Morgan doesn't hesitate and heads out immediately. Actually, just as January questioned before, you're about to destroy the station, so what's the point of saving these people? I've wondered the same thing more than once while playing, but in the end,. humanity always triumphs over logic. Faced with the need I injected the booster, brought Mikhaila back from the brink of death, and restarted the reactor, restoring power to this sector. Alex also sent a message , inviting the protagonist to his office to watch a video together, hoping Morgan might make a different decision after seeing it. Arriving at the office, I found Alex wasn't there; he stood me up , but I still managed to find the video on his computer. This footage was recorded when Morgan first used a Neuromod infused with Typhon abilities. Morgan built devices he thought could control the Typhons, constantly studying their abilities, hoping to use them to enhance humanity and even extend human life. Each time Morgan removed a Neuromod, he lost his memory, and his personality changed—this is a side effect of the Neuromods. That’s why his brother Alex built a lab, intending to find a way to normalize Morgan through constant resets. a plan to achieve that . As for what happened afterward, everyone knows: the Typhons throughout the base broke loose, leading to the current state of affairs. Without his memories, Morgan didn't know the truth. and thought his brother was keeping him trapped in the same day for fear that he would destroy the station, which is why he left those recordings and an operator to help himself. The brothers had already developed a wave emitter capable of countering the Typhons, but it still requires scanning Coral to be fully completed. Alex stated that once Morgan collects the Coral data and gives it to him, he will hand over the arming keys. Then, whether we trigger the self-destruct or trust the wave emitter to destroy the Typhons, it will be up to us to decide. While trying to figure out how to scan the Coral, a spacecraft.

rapidly approached Talos I. A man named Dahl arrived with a group of killer machines, claiming he was sent by the Board of Directors to take over the station and eliminate the Yu brothers. Wait a minute, isn't this a family business? Does this mean the father wants to kill his two sons? It really seems so. With the arrival of the ship, the battlefield on the station now includes military drones in addition to the Typhons. These things are even harder to deal with than the Typhons, and since every employee wears a bracelet, Dahl knows exactly where we are at all times. However, there is an escape pod on the station, and we now know its exact. location; if we run for it, it will be quite a journey. We cannot just abandon Talos I, otherwise, the Typhon on board will invade Earth. Deserting the station is only the worst-case scenario; under normal circumstances, no one would do that. Morgan engages in a massive battle against Dahl's robot army on the station , finally locating the leader, Dahl, in Life Support. Using the oxygen system's sterilization sequence to briefly knock him unconscious, we can then seal him away with the Gloo Cannon. Back in the Arboretum, a secret door appears behind the office. It turns out my brother Alex has been hiding behind his office all along; he has discovered that the Coral acts as a neural network for the Typhon . Alex gave us the schematics for the. Nullwave Transmitter, a device that can send a powerful electrical shock through neural signals to any connected Typhon, effectively destroying them. As he was speaking, a massive Typhon suddenly appeared behind us, and Alex was knocked unconscious by the impact. How could I miss this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity ? I quickly scavenged the arming key from him and managed to drag him into the escape pod. Now it is Morgan's turn to make a choice. If you killed Dahl earlier, you cannot evacuate with the others and must take the escape pod alone, leaving all the survivors to perish on Talos I. But if. you didn't kill Dahl, you can board his shuttle at the last moment to escape with the other NPCs before the explosion , or use the Nullwave Transmitter to destroy the Typhon on the station. I consider this the perfect ending: everyone on the station survives, Earth is saved, and the brothers can continue their... Is. Is that all?

Whether you destroy the Coral or blow up the station, you will see this scene after the credits roll. My brother Alex appears before me, and our true identity is revealed to be that of a Typhon undergoing testing. Everything we experienced was just a simulation. Looking back at those test phases, it all makes sense; they were testing whether the protagonist, this Typhon, had developed human empathy and what choices it would make when facing life-or-death situations. To Alex's left are four Operators, and the important NPCs we met along the way were all played by them. On the left is my. girlfriend, Mikhaila; moving to the right, we have Sarah, a survivor leader trapped in space, and Xiu, the head of security. Whether we choose to save them in the game or just turn our backs and walk away, it will influence the evaluation given by these machines. If the rating is too low, the test results will be deemed unsatisfactory, and just like the escape ending, our memory will be reset to start a new cycle. If our actions in the game satisfy them , Alex will believe we have passed the test. On the big screen, we see that Earth has actually fallen, and as an evolved. Typhon, we must build a bridge of communication between humanity and the Typhon. The game gives the choice to the player multiple times, and this is another one : if you choose to kill everyone, Alex will be heartlessly eliminated. >> Choosing to shake hands means we now see humans as companions or friends. As a human and a Typhon clasp hands, they become the key to the survival of all. mankind. Prey is a fantastic game. Reflecting on it after finishing, I realized many designs were actually very clever. For instance, while playing, you always feel the NPCs have ulterior motives, but it makes perfect sense once you beat the game: they were all there to test if the protagonist, a Typhon, had truly gained human emotions. As players, we often know what is morally right, but because it is just a game, we don't really care. If you clear the game with a reckless attitude, you will trigger a bad ending . The visuals and gameplay of Prey are also excellent; even by today's standards, it is a masterpiece and. definitely worth playing. Please leave a like, and we will continue to share interesting content.

值得閱讀的理由

  • 了解《拳皇2000》如何以豐富的援護系統，串連系列舊角色、跨作品客串與隱藏彩蛋。
  • 掌握音巢篇的重要劇情，從大賽背後的陰謀到複製零企圖奪取衛星砲的力量。
  • 一次回顧各隊伍的賽後結局，認識角色關係與後續故事的發展。

摘要

大賽集結，各方勢力登場

作者回顧《拳皇2000》作為舊 SNK 破產前的重要作品，指出遊戲除了美術風格有所轉變，也將系列的援護系統推向新高度。延續《拳皇99》的音巢組織陰謀，K'與麥克西姆為了調查真相，與特工凡妮莎、摔角手拉蒙組成主角隊參賽。各路熟悉面孔也紛紛組隊，迎接新一屆格鬥大賽。

援護系統與隱藏角色

本作由三名角色上場對戰，並由第四名角色提供援護；大量援護角色更擁有不同形態，當中包括系列舊角、跨作品客串角色，以及過往未採用的造型。作者也介紹了透過特殊指令才能召喚的隱藏援護，例如草薙柴舟、藤堂龍白、問答遊戲角色與吉祥物 G-Mantle，呈現遊戲藏在系統中的各種驚喜。

複製零的陰謀與危機

大賽進入尾聲，外太空的零式大砲將南鎮列為攻擊目標，哈迪蘭上校也遭到摯友凌司令背叛。主角隊擊敗改造人庫拉後深入地下，發現幕後黑手竟是音巢幹部複製零。複製零企圖利用大賽收集格鬥家的力量，轉化為衛星砲的能源，藉此背叛音巢；眾人合力擊敗他後，哈迪蘭破壞控制裝置，失控發射的大砲反而擊中複製零。

角色結局與各自的去向

危機過後，拉蒙背著受傷的凡妮莎撤離，兩人的關係也流露出微妙情愫。庫拉登上衛星大砲，親手將炮口轉向複製零，機器人 Candy 則犧牲自己救下她。怒隊結局中，薇普取得複製零的人體改造資料，並決定離開哈迪蘭、走自己的路；K'則找回童年記憶，得知薇普與自己有姐弟關係，兩人決定聯手向音巢復仇。

各隊伍的後續故事

紅丸隊遭遇投靠音巢的前飛賊首領「龍」，使賽斯更加憂心音巢勢力擴張。餓狼隊的特瑞在混亂中失蹤後平安現身，與瑪莉重逢；龍虎之拳隊則由坂崎琢磨出手化解瓊面臨的危機。超能力戰士隊方面，包反彈大砲能量後受傷，椎拳崇在擔憂中親吻他，意外喚醒體內的龍之氣並恢復超能力。

鬧劇收尾與宿命對決

女性格鬥家隊結局中，四條雛子重返相撲賽場，不知火舞等人前來加油，卻因被觀眾認出而引發騷動。韓國隊的弟子遭大砲波及後發生身體互換，金家藩與全勛只好繼續追查音巢，尋找恢復原狀的方法。草薙京與八神庵則在戰後相遇，兩名宿敵再次展開對決。

作品回顧

作者最後回顧《拳皇2000》對援護系統的拓展，以及作品如何透過眾多角色結局延伸音巢篇故事，並預告《拳皇2001》將迎來安琪爾、K9999等新角色，讓音巢篇繼續發展。

值得閱讀的理由

  • 深入解析《陰森之子》與前作《陰森》錯綜複雜的世界觀關聯，釐清跨代劇情的神秘脈絡。
  • 詳解主角在危機四伏的島嶼上求生、對抗黃金面具食人族與地底變異畸形生物的驚險過程。
  • 揭露帕夫集團、前作角色提米（Timmy）的平行宇宙理論，以及神秘「索拉菲特」礦石與黃金立方體的真實面貌。

摘要

墜機生還與搜救的殘酷開端

主角傭兵Jack跟隨搜救隊搭乘直升機前往帕夫集團買下的豪華度假島嶼，旨在尋找失蹤31週的集團董事長Edward Puff及其妻女。不料直升機在空中遭遇不明武裝襲擊墜毀，Jack 在被神秘人擊昏後倖存，身邊僅留下一只多功能背包與受傷失聰的隊友Kelvin。作者指出，隨著利用 GPS 尋找其他成員，Jack 陸續發現吊掛崖壁與死在救生筏上的同伴，甚至遍地可見礦工與前批搜救人員的遺體，整座島嶼早已淪為殘酷的殺戮場。

through the rift, the golden cube is finally right before our eyes. The notebook in my hand is counting down; it’s the activation time for the cube, and there are only a few dozen seconds left. 墜機生還與搜救的殘酷開端
